workItem.title: Bridge-readiness: MIT runtime settings CLI terminal I/O adapter IAU candidate

dockerImageFacts.publicWording: Docker provider selection uses the latest supported NI LabVIEW Docker image family; the current Linux default maps to LabVIEW 2026 and Docker exposes no user-facing bitness choice.

targetGap.summary: The MIT authority has pure command, selection, entrypoint, and prompt-loop contracts, but it has no public import, Spec Kit feature, admission record, or clean-room terminal session adapter for no-argument vihs terminal I/O behavior.

splitDecision.reason: Terminal session adaptation is the next discoverability unit after prompt-loop closeout, but it should be admitted as a testable adapter around the existing prompt-loop contract before compare execution, runtime execution, proof expansion, packaging, or Marketplace behavior.
